tagline: Back big rigs into docks, haul loads, and wreck the yard doing it.
description:
Gladhand Dockyard is a pixel truck sim about backing trailers into docks. Hook up your tractor, connect the red and blue air lines, and back the trailer into an open door without flattening the fence, the forklifts or the yard crew.

Drive with the on screen steering wheel, the D, N and R gears and the gas and brake pedals. Switch between top down cameras and a first person driver view with working mirrors. Every hit dents both vehicles, fences bend and structures cave in. A short tutorial walks you through your first dock.

The free demo includes the Dock yard and the Haul route, every trailer load, and every ride you can find there and honk next to. Buy it to unlock the City, with live signals, traffic and warehouse docks, and the endless Highway.

Plays in your phone or desktop browser.
